is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 3, 4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports Vgsc L995F, Vgsc L995S, and Gste2 CNVs (page 2, 4, 14, 15).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figures 3 and 4 provide allele/CNV frequencies for specific cohorts (page 14, 15).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from the field in western Ethiopia (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study presenting original whole-genome sequencing data (page 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided for Gambella and Benishangul-Gumuz regions (page 3, 12).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new study presenting original data from 2023 collections.

supplement.evidence: The main figures provide the necessary frequency data.

assessment.summary: This study uses whole-genome sequencing to characterize Anopheles gambiae s.s. populations in western Ethiopia, reporting frequencies of insecticide resistance markers including Vgsc-L995F/S and Gste2 CNVs.
